Thanks Logan — reviewed the draft and the comp grid. High-level comments:

- Base: $185k is within band for SDE III at about the 55th percentile; acceptable.
- Bonus: 15% target is standard — obvious to include prorate language.
- Equity: 0.35% is modest; given market comps and candidate experience I recommend 0.40% RSU (4y, 1y cliff). That brings total cash + equity to a more competitive position without blowing the band.
- Sign-on: candidate's counter includes a $25k retention element. To win this at the margin I recommend increasing sign-on to $25k, or keep at $15k but concede a $10k retention payment after 6 months (we do this occasionally).

Operational checks:
- Please confirm hiring manager has approval for the extra sign-on/equity delta vs original hiring plan (budget/ILC). If not, we will require comp committee sign-off.
- I've updated comp_grid_sde3_q4.xlsx with the suggested 0.40% note — see tab "JChen_note".

If the team is comfortable with either:
Option A (aggressive): Base $185k, sign-on $25k, equity 0.40%
Option B (split): Base $190k, sign-on $20k, equity 0.40% (manager to confirm budget)

Happy to escalate to comp committee if you want HR to request formal exception.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
